results.title: GEO Analytics Dashboard displays correctly

steps.title: Given an authenticated Editor opens the GEO Analytics Dashboard
Then the heading GEO Analytics Dashboard is visible
And the subtitle Monitor your presence across AI search engines is visible
And the New Analysis button is visible
And the 6 stat cards COUNTRIES CATEGORIES COMPETITORS ANALYSES PROMPTS SOURCES are displayed
And the Analysis table is visible with columns Brand / Topic Countries Categories Prompts Last update and Actions
Then the CATEGORIES stat card total equals the sum of category chips displayed in the table
And the ANALYSES stat card total equals the number of rows in the Analysis table

results.notes: Main account (SUPER_ADMIN) used as Editor. Heading "GEO Analytics Dashboard", subtitle "Monitor your presence across AI search engines", New Analysis button. Stat cards in order COUNTRIES 18 / CATEGORIES 14 / COMPETITORS 78 / ANALYSES 7 / PROMPTS 804 / SOURCES 1824. Table headers: Brand / Topic, Countries, Categories, Prompts, Last update, Actions. 7 rows (adidas, bike, Decathlon, Lictorix Geo, Nike, Orange, Toyota), 2 category chips each = 14 = CATEGORIES card; 7 rows = ANALYSES card; no Show more needed.

results.title: Find a brand analysis on the GEO dashboard with its prompt pool and open it
results.error: Step 2 — Expected: next to the number of analyses (e.g. "5 analyses"), the ring reads "U / P". Observed: the Analysis table header shows "Analysis" + ring "804 / 1500 prompts" (aria-label "Prompt pool: 804 / 1500 prompts"); no "N analyses" label is displayed (red frame on step1_given). Known change: GEO-1546 removes the duplicated "N analyses" label — test text to align.

Then a pool block is shown in the header of the Analysis table
When the user hovers the ring
Then a "Prompts" column is shown after Categories
And the column adds up to the pool block
When the list shows analysis UA
And brand analyses keep their logo and domain
When the Editor locates the brand row in the reports list
When the Editor clicks on the brand analysis row

results.notes: Step 3: popover "Prompt pool 804 of 1500 — In use across analyses 804 — Free in the pool 696" (U and P-U split OK). Step 5: Prompts column 168+47+203+70+3+140+173 = 804 = U. Step 6: header "Brand / Topic" with unbranded "bike" row. Step 7: brand rows keep favicon logo + domain. Steps 8-10 run with Toyota (staging default brand analysis; JDD_PROFILE Dyson/YSL analysis absent on staging) → /dashboard/439acd96-0b1b-4da4-9e07-612d38e9783e. Steps 11-14 SKIP: they need the YSL analysis (US + FR, Claude only) created by E2E-MARKETS-1LLM-001, not present in QA-GEO staging; analysis creation excluded by the user (read-only run). Toyota has US/FR/ES and 4 engines (no Claude), so these checks are not applicable to it.
